target.title: fix(core): surface non_deliverable_terminal_turn as outbound fallback to channel plugins
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #102113

When `resolveAttemptTrajectoryTerminal()` classifies a run as `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` (e.g. `stopReason=toolUse` with no committed delivery evidence, or no visible output produced), the `terminalError` field was written only to the trajectory recorder and never propagated to `EmbeddedAgentRunResult.meta`. As a result:

- `agent-runner-execution.ts` never set `terminalRunFailed=true` for this case
- `followup-runner.ts` built no fallback payload
- `message_tool_only` channels (e.g. openclaw-channel-octo) received nothing and went completely silent

## Root Cause

`attempt-trajectory-status.ts` sets `terminalError: NON_DELIVERABLE_TERMINAL_TURN_REASON` on the `AttemptTrajectoryTerminal` object, but `attempt.ts` only forwarded this field to the trajectory recorder — **not to the returned attempt object**. Consequently, `EmbeddedAgentRunMeta` had no way to signal this condition downstream.

In `agent-runner-execution.ts`, the `else if (deferredLifecycleError || embeddedError)` guard only fires on `meta.error` (which tracks a different error kind). `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` was invisible there.

In `followup-runner.ts`, even when `terminalRunFailed=true`, the `run.sourceReplyDeliveryMode !== "message_tool_only"` guard blocks the fallback for channels that use message tool as their sole delivery path — which is exactly the case for Octo.

## Fix (5 files, +17/-3)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `types.ts` | Add `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn?: true` to `EmbeddedAgentRunMeta` |
| `attempt.ts` | Expose the flag in the attempt return value |
| `run.ts` | Pass it through to `meta` in the normal terminal return path |
| `agent-runner-execution.ts` | Read `meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` → set `terminalRunFailed=true` + supply user-facing fallback text `"The agent run failed before producing a reply."` |
| `followup-runner.ts` | Allow `message_tool_only` mode to still deliver the terminal failure payload when `nonDeliverableTerminalTurn` is true |

## Path Reachability

```
resolveAttemptTrajectoryTerminal()           // attempt-trajectory-status.ts:103
  └─ stopReason=toolUse + no delivery evidence
       → terminalError: NON_DELIVERABLE_TERMINAL_TURN_REASON  // :131

runEmbeddedAttempt() return                  // attempt.ts:5957 (new)
  └─ nonDeliverableTerminalTurn: true

runEmbeddedAgentInternal() meta              // run.ts:4258 (new)
  └─ meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn: true

runAgentTurnWithFallbackInternal()           // agent-runner-execution.ts:3242 (new)
  └─ else if (...|| meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn)
       → terminalRunFailed = true
       → terminalErrorMessage = "The agent run failed before producing a reply."

createFollowupRunner()                       // followup-runner.ts:1567 (new)
  └─ (sourceReplyDeliveryMode !== "message_tool_only"
      || meta.nonDeliverableTerminalTurn)    // bypass message_tool_only gate
       → buildTerminalAgentRunFailureReplyPayload(...)
       → fallback delivered to channel
```

## Reproduction

Trigger: Octo agent turn where `stopReason=toolUse` and delivery evidence is not committed (message tool call completes but `hasCommittedOutboundDeliveryEvidence` returns false). The user previously saw no response.

Expected after fix: User receives `"The agent run failed before producing a reply."`

## Impact

- All `message_tool_only` channels (Octo and others) now receive the fallback text on `non_deliverable_terminal_turn`
- Non-`message_tool_only` channels: no behavior change (the `message_tool_only` guard was never reached for them)
- Heartbeat runs: unaffected (`isInteractive=false` guard still fires first)
- Silent runs (`silentExpected=true`): unaffected (guarded earlier in `buildEmptyInteractiveReplyPayload`)

## Related

- Issue: #102113
- Channel-side tracking: Mininglamp-OSS/openclaw-channel-octo#150
